7761-falkland-complete.title: Falkland Complete
7761-falkland-complete.creator: Edward Bulwer-Lytton
7761-falkland-complete.description: A book by Edward Bulwer-Lytton. t is only upon the minds of the young that the works of sentiment have any appreciable moral influence. But the sentiment of each age is peculiar to itself; and the purely moral influence of sentimental fiction seldom survives the age to which it was first addressed.

arxiv-2008-00113.title: Multi-officer Routing for Patrolling High Risk Areas Jointly Learned from Check-ins, Crime and Incident Response Data
arxiv-2008-00113.creator: Shakila Khan Rumi, Kyle K. Qin, and Flora D. Salim
arxiv-2008-00113.description: Abstract A well-crafted police patrol route design is vital in providing community safety and security in the society. Previous works have largely focused on predicting crime events with historical crime data. The usage of large-scale mobility data collected from Location-Based Social Network, or check-ins, and Point of Interests (POI) data for designing an effective police patrol is largely understudied.

arxiv-2103-06478.title: Deep Multiway Canonical Correlation Analysis for Multi-subject EEG Normalization
arxiv-2103-06478.creator: Jaswanth Reddy Katthi, Sriram Ganapathy
arxiv-2103-06478.description: Abstract The normalization of brain recordings from multiple subjects responding to the natural stimuli is one of the key challenges in auditory neuroscience. The objective of this normalization is to transform the brain data in such a way as to remove the inter-subject redundancies and to boost the component related to the stimuli.

arxiv-2104-12487.title: Space-time structure in the microcosm and its relation to the properties of elementary particles
arxiv-2104-12487.description: Abstract QUANTUM PHYSICS UDC 51-71, 515.173 The relations between the hidden symmetries of the six-dimensional pseudo-Euclidean space with signature (+\;+\;+\;-\;-\;-) and the conserved quantum characteristics of elementary particles is established. The hidden symmetries are brought out by the various forms of representation of the pseudo-Euclidean space metric with the aid of spinors and hyperbolic complex numbers.

arxiv-2309-10716.title: Learning Model Predictive Control with Error Dynamics Regression for Autonomous Racing
arxiv-2309-10716.creator: Haoru Xue, Edward L. Zhu, John M. Dolan, Francesco Borrelli
arxiv-2309-10716.description: Abstract This work presents a novel Learning Model Predictive Control (LMPC) strategy for autonomous racing at the handling limit that can iteratively explore and learn unknown dynamics in high-speed operational domains. We start from existing LMPC formulations and modify the system dynamics learning method.

arxiv-2310-02991.title: Diagnostic Tomography of Applied Holography
arxiv-2310-02991.creator: D. V. Khveshchenko
arxiv-2310-02991.description: Abstract The single-particle behavior in d ≥ 1 d\geq 1 -dimensional Fermi gases with a large number N N of species and strong short-range s s -wave scattering is discussed in the 2 ​ d 2d ’tomographic’ framework of a (pseudo)holographic correspondence with a certain 3 ​ d 3d gravity of the A ​ d ​ S 3 AdS_{3} type.

arxiv-2406-14532.title: RL on Incorrect Synthetic Data Scales the Efficiency of LLM Math Reasoning by Eight-Fold
arxiv-2406-14532.creator: Amrith Setlur, Saurabh Garg, Xinyang (Young) Geng, Naman Garg, Virginia Smith, Aviral Kumar
arxiv-2406-14532.description: Abstract Training on model-generated synthetic data is a promising approach for finetuning LLMs, but it remains unclear when it helps or hurts. In this paper, we investigate this question for math reasoning via an empirical study, followed by building a conceptual understanding of our observations.

arxiv-2408-02807.title: Optimal Gaussian Strategies for Vector-valued Witsenhausen Counterexample with Non-causal State Estimator
arxiv-2408-02807.creator: Mengyuan Zhao, Tobias J. Oechtering, Maël Le Treust
arxiv-2408-02807.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate a vector-valued Witsenhausen model where the second dm ( dm ) acquires a vector of observations before selecting a vector of estimations. Here, the first dm acts causally whereas the second dm estimates non-causally.

arxiv-2412-09436.title: Backreaction inclusive Schwinger effect
arxiv-2412-09436.creator: Shagun Kaushal, Suprit Singh
arxiv-2412-09436.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shagun Kaushal, Suprit Singh. We employ a self-consistent framework to study the backreaction effects of particle creation in coupled semiclassical dynamics of a quantum complex scalar field and a classical electric field in both Minkowski and de Sitter spacetimes. This approach utilizes a general formalism to analyze the evolution of Gaussian states of a quantized field, in the Schrödinger picture in the presence of a background electric field.

pmc-11366588.title: Functional genomics identifies a small secreted protein that plays a role during the biotrophic to necrotrophic shift in the root rot pathogen Phytophthora medicaginis
pmc-11366588.creator: Donovin W. Coles, Sean L. Bithell, Thomas Jeffries, William S. Cuddy, Jonathan M. Plett
pmc-11366588.description: IntroductionHemibiotrophic Phytophthora are a group of agriculturally and ecologically important pathogenic oomycetes causing severe decline in plant growth and fitness. The lifestyle of these pathogens consists of an initial biotrophic phase followed by a switch to a necrotrophic phase in the latter stages of infection.

pmc-11435211.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Characterization of MYB Transcription Factors in Sudan Grass under Drought Stress
pmc-11435211.creator: Qiuxu Liu, Yalin Xu, Xiangyan Li, Tiangang Qi, Bo Li, Hong Wang, Yongqun Zhu, Vagner A Benedito
pmc-11435211.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Sudan grass (Sorghum sudanense S.) is a warm-season annual grass with high yield, rich nutritional value, good regeneration, and tolerance to biotic and abiotic stresses. However, prolonged drought affects the yield and quality of Sudan grass. As one of the largest families of multifunctional transcription factors in plants, MYB is widely involved in regulating plant growth and development, hormonal signaling, and stress responses at the gene transcription level.

pmc-11568885.title: Detection of Airway Obstruction Caused by Mochi in a Decomposed Body Using Postmortem CT
pmc-11568885.creator: Haruki Fukuda, Takuya Ishikawa, Rie Sano, Yoshihiko Kominato, Hiroyuki Tokue
pmc-11568885.description: Postmortem CT (PMCT) is widely used in forensic investigations to determine the causes of death and is particularly effective in trauma cases and for detecting foreign bodies such as gas or metallic fragments. However, PMCT utility in cases of advanced postmortem changes remains poorly explored.

pmc-12468171.title: The EBV-Positive Tumor Methylome Is Distinct from EBV-Negative in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
pmc-12468171.creator: Ashley K Volaric, Ramiro Barrantes-Reynolds, Karine Sahakyan, Yuri Fedoriw, Seth Frietze, Kwok-Wai Lo
pmc-12468171.description: Simple SummaryEpstein–Barr virus (EBV) is a ubiquitous virus associated with the development of B-cell lymphoma, including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) arising in the setting of immunodeficiency and dysregulation. EBV-associated DLBCL is more clinically aggressive than EBV(−) disease, but targeted therapeutic options have not been developed.

pmc-12618534.title: Bacteria associated with the cereal leaf beetle act as the insect’s allies in adapting to protease inhibitors, but impair its development in laboratory condition
pmc-12618534.creator: Beata Wielkopolan, Alicja Szabelska-Beręsewicz, Aleksandra Obrępalska-Stęplowska
pmc-12618534.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Oulema melanopus [L.] (cereal leaf beetle, CLB) is one of the most serious cereal pests. Plant protease inhibitors (PIs) are known for their insecticidal properties. The role of CLB-associated bacteria in insect adaptation to PIs is not yet known. We investigated the role of CLB-associated bacteria in adaptation to PIs, and whether the reduction of bacteria will affect the CLB development.

pmc-12619542.title: A 21-Practice Evaluation of an Asthma and COPD Quality Improvement Program
pmc-12619542.creator: John D Blakey, Sinthia Bosnic-Anticevich, Biljana Cvetkovski, Kerry L Hancock, Porsche Le Cheng, Freya Tyrer, John Townend, Mark Hew, Peter Del Fante, Kanchanamala Ranasinghe, Philip J Thompson, Peter K Smith, Majella Soumakiyan, Deb Stewart, Anita Sharma, Bruce Willet, Kamila Abutalieva-Lechner, Ch
pmc-12619542.description: PurposeTo evaluate the Achieving Clinical Audits with Electronic Records (ACAER) program in supporting primary care providers in quality improvement initiatives across asthma and COPD.Patients and methodsThis observational cohort study included individuals aged ≥12 years with documented diagnosis of asthma or COPD, receiving asthma or COPD therapy, at high risk of exacerbation and hospitalization.

pmc-13164960.title: Synthesis and Spectroscopic Characterization of Benzimidazole-Derived Schiff Base: Investigation of Optical Properties, DNA Binding, DFT, and Molecular Docking
pmc-13164960.creator: Ahmed N. Alhakimi, Sadeq M. Al-Hazmy, Ibrahim A. Alhagri, Sabri Messaoudi, Ahmed Kaid Alantry, Tahani Alresheedi
pmc-13164960.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study reports the synthesis and characterization of a novel benzimidazole-derived Schiff base (BIMPB) via the condensation of (1H-benzo[d]imidazol-2-yl)methanamine with 1-phenylbutane-1,3-dione. The structure was confirmed using 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR and FT-IR spectroscopy. Photophysical properties were extensively evaluated, revealing a strong S0 → S2 transition at 212 nm and fluorescence emission peaks at 396 and 410 nm, corresponding to π → π* and n → π* transitions. BIMPB demonstrated significant sensitivity to pH variations, exhibiting blue shifts of 11–23 nm across different environments.

pmc-13166838.title: Outcomes of intravascular lithotripsy for calcified femoropopliteal and infrapopliteal artery disease: A systematic review with qualitative synthesis
pmc-13166838.creator: Yasser Kofiah
pmc-13166838.description: Background:Heavily calcified peripheral artery disease (PAD) lesions limit the effectiveness of standard endovascular techniques and increase complication risk. This study systematically evaluates the safety and efficacy of intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) as a calcium-modifying therapy.Methods:A systematic literature search was performed using PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science for studies published between 2020 and July 2025.

pmc-13392376.title: Impact of mucilage incorporation into xanthan gum on the physical and textural characteristics of gluten-free bread during short-term storage
pmc-13392376.creator: Vhuhwavho Maphaha, Frederick Tawi Tabit
pmc-13392376.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Gluten-free bread often exhibits poor texture and low volume, necessitating the use of hydrocolloids such as xanthan gum and plant-derived mucilage to improve structural and sensory quality. This study investigated the effects of partially substituting xanthan gum with okra mucilage at 25, 50, and 75% levels on the physicochemical, textural, and sensory properties of gluten‑free bread during 72 h of storage.

uslaw-usc-t42-s300z1.title: 42 U.S.C. § 300z–1 — Definitions; regulations applicable
uslaw-usc-t42-s300z1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s300z1.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 6A (Public Health Service); Subchapter XVIII (Adolescent Family Life Demonstration Projects). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) For the purposes of this subchapter, the term— (1) “Secretary” means the Secretary of Health and Human Services; (2) “eligible person” means— (A) with regard to the provision of care services, a pregnant adolescent.
